data.title: Amazon Just Handed Qualcomm a Slice of AWS’s AI Buildout
data.description: AWS is sitting on a $496 billion backlog and doubling its power capacity, and the pressure is now pulling a surprising new name into the AI silicon race alongside Broadcom. Whether that newcomer can actually deliver before the window closes is the real question.
